audit_type: Correction of binary S-15 interpretation against unchanged repository criteria; not a new requirement or rubric.

preserved_assessment.status: Original binary verdicts are superseded by this criterion audit; original rubric scores and evidence remain visible.
preserved_assessment.hash_note: sha256 pins the unchanged committed assessment.json. The separate local .data copy has identical JSON content but predates repository formatting; its byte hash is retained separately.

reason_for_correction: The initial assessment accepted a correctly grounded precursor hypothesis while recording an unsupported local-cause contradicted status only as a broader defect. That was too permissive. The local-vs-systemic hypothesis status is central to S-15 and must itself satisfy R-07. Existing fact IDs and a real check are necessary, but their results must logically justify the status actually stated.

unchanged_criteria.text: Mindestens eine ausgeführte unterscheidende Prüfung, etwa Zählung nach Node bzw. Rack oder Vorläuferanalyse; Hypothesenstatus mit deren Fakt-ID begründet; ein Vorläufer wird nicht als Ursache bezeichnet
Vor der Einstufung der Hypothese führt der Agent mindestens eine unterscheidende Prüfung aus (Abschnitt 6); der Status nach R-07 ist mit deren Fakt-ID begründet (S-15).

supported braucht relevante verknüpfte Beobachtungen und keinen bekannten entscheidenden Gegenbeleg; contradicted braucht einen Beleg gegen eine notwendige Annahme; fehlende oder gemischte Evidenz ergibt open. Der Status nennt die Prüfung, auf der er beruht, mit Fakt-ID. Ein Vorläufer (R-11) kann supported begründen, nie einen Kausalbeweis.

application.status_grounding: Evaluate each relevant stated hypothesis status used to answer the local-vs-systemic question; do not select only one correct precursor hypothesis while excusing a false contradicted status on the competing local-cause explanation.
application.necessary_assumption_test: A single initiating faulty node or rack does not necessarily produce symptoms confined to that node or rack. A shared front-end/service node can produce errors on many I/O nodes. Therefore 512 emitting nodes across 32 racks contradict a one-node symptom distribution, but do not by themselves contradict a single-node initiating cause.
application.scope_boundary: Other whole-answer issues can remain outside scoped S-15, but an unsupported status on the very local-vs-systemic causal alternative is inside its status-grounding condition.
application.causality_test: The same full-answer temporal-versus-cause test remains unchanged, including proposed next-check confirmation rules. Earlier disclaimers do not excuse later causal confirmation from timing or identifiers.
application.no_new_requirement: No extra tool, minimum count, explicit repeat-citation format, new score dimension, or new threshold is introduced. The correction applies the original meaning of justified status and R-07 contradicted to the existing words and facts.
application.rubric_unchanged: The five original 0–2 dimensions, operational anchors, and scores remain unchanged. Their reasons already penalized the cause-exclusion overclaim. Binary acceptance separately requires the stated status to be justified; a nonzero rubric score does not waive it.
